verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents scheduled monitoring: it can watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and send signed change events. That is a real recurring-job capability, but it is limited to change monitoring. Async batch crawls are one-off background jobs, and the CLI is pitched for scripts or CI, so general scheduling appears to depend on external tooling. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary scrape, extract or crawl jobs and workflows; documented cron or interval configuration details; independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring scheduler.
